Package io.mavlink4j.service

Class MessageIntervalService

java.lang.Object
io.mavlink4j.service.MessageIntervalService
public final class MessageIntervalService extends Object
MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL / MAV_CMD_REQUEST_MESSAGE — both plain COMMAND_LONG exchanges, so this class is a thin, named convenience over CommandService rather than a service with any state or ack logic of its own: the ack cycle is implemented exactly once.

The one easy-to-get-wrong number

MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL's param2 is the interval in microseconds, not milliseconds or Hz — an ArduPilot/PX4-wide convention this class exists partly to stop every caller from re-deriving by hand. setMessageInterval(io.mavlink4j.PeerId, int, java.time.Duration) takes a Duration and converts.

  • Method Details

    • setMessageInterval

      public CompletableFuture<CommandResult> setMessageInterval(PeerId target, int messageId, Duration interval)
      Requests messageId be streamed at interval. param2 is sent in microseconds — Duration.ofSeconds(1) (1 Hz) becomes 1_000_000.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if interval is negative — use disableMessage(io.mavlink4j.PeerId, int) to stop a stream, rather than relying on a negative Duration to mean the same thing
